nodes.label: Public Enrollment Portal
nodes.rationale: A public unauthenticated intake portal that lets a prospective student apply without an account and a registrar review/approve into real student accounts. Not a new enrollment system - a new front door that on approval produces exactly the same Account+Profile+StudentSchoolYear+StudentProgramEnrollment records a registrar creates manually today. Reuse-not-reimplementation is the single most important constraint.

nodes.label: Anonymous OTP-Verified Applicant
nodes.rationale: Anonymous visitor, no account, identified only by a personal email verified via OTP each visit; never logs in with a password until approved. One application per email per org per school year (unique constraint) - OTP verify doubles as the do-you-already-have-an-application check.

nodes.label: Registrar Actor
nodes.rationale: An Account with role=admin and is_registrar=true. Reviews, approves, rejects, and manually unlocks applications; same person who does manual enrollment today, just with a new queue.

nodes.label: EnrollmentPeriod Model
nodes.rationale: The window concept: org, school year, start/end/lock dates, and the shareable token (/enroll/{org-slug}/{period-token}). An org can have multiple periods open at once; dates entirely at admin discretion.

nodes.label: EnrollmentApplication Model
nodes.rationale: Applicant submission: identity (personal email), entered data, program/course/level selection, random 4-char application code (friendly lookup token, not cryptographically strong), status lifecycle pending -> locked -> approved or pending/locked -> rejected -> pending on resubmit.

nodes.label: Application Lifecycle (pending>locked>approved)
nodes.rationale: Approval is terminal, rejection is not. Locking is time-based and automatic (scheduler sweep) but reversible by a human (registrar manual unlock). Section is never applicant-chosen - auto-assigned by a defined fill order (added Section.order_index). Gap between lock_date and end_date gives registrars a stable batch while latecomers can still apply.

nodes.label: Application Approval (Account+Profile+SSY+SPE Creation)
nodes.rationale: Approval triggers the existing enrollment-creation logic to produce Account + Profile + StudentSchoolYear + StudentProgramEnrollment; section auto-assigned in fill order; credentials emailed to personal email (the only notification target pre-account); approved is terminal.
